en: I don't care about apologies, just get
out of here. This is a match factory.
It's dangerous!
Sorry to have caused a commotion.
Oh, it's you. You can't be here, get out.
I keep telling you it's dangerous. You just don't get it, do you?
I keep telling you not to come in here.
The other workers were bothered too.
This is no place to wander into for fun.
...Look at my fingers.
They're half melted away, see?
The stuff we use for matches is poison.
Now that you know, clear off, will you?
Did someone say you could look around?
If you feel sick or anything happens, we
can't be held responsible, you know.
I bet you're rich.
Must be nice, living however you like.
I got myself a wife, sure, but life is
hard, and the work's rough... Haah.
Just here to gawk?
You must be idle. A rich man's pastime, is it?
Though there's a rumor you're a detective.
Who are you?
...Oh, from the mansion where Agnes works?
Huh, guess not.
You want something?
What's the reason you're
loitering around here?
I'd rather you didn't come to the factory,
but coming to my house is fine, I guess.
Fancy a rich man coming to a dump like this.
Well, have a look if it amuses you.
Try not to come by the factory too often.
Officially, it's off-limits to outsiders.
You're done with hard toil and poverty.
Live on as my servant...
Now, the battle begins. Watch and see...
Ah, I'm sorry.
I was getting my bearings as I walked.
Then do it at the side of the pavement.
I'd like to ask the way, if I may.
Sure, but I don't know the area that well.
I usually just go between factory and home.
Good afternoon. Is this place off-limits?
I'm terribly sorry.
...I see.
I understand. Sorry for the trouble.
So it was you. You can't be here, get out.
Just here to gawk? You must be idle.
Is that just another rich man's pastime?
There's a rumor you're a detective, but
you sure don't look like one.
Eh? You're not?
Do you need something?
What on earth brings you
wandering around these parts?
but, well, coming to my house is fine.
Give this Jack your orders...
I am Max...
But that is a false name.
I've no need to reveal my true name, after all.
Is there something you want with me?
Something you need?
...Yes?
...Heh heh heh.
You're an odd one too, aren't you?
The borrowed name the world gave me is
Jack.
Yes, I am Jack the Ripper.
Or so I might claim, but whether it's true
or not, you couldn't tell, could you?
In the end, that's all it's worth,
something like the truth.
I hear you've been looking for me?
...I have.
Faintly... the smell... of blood...
...from your lips.
If you like... I could help you, you know?
After all, you seem to be up to something
